# Daily Briefing – 19 January 2026

Yesterday was a solid low-key day — no structured training, but 10,901 steps kept you nicely active and your 2,466 kcal burn sat comfortably above your 2,300 target, which is a good sign your metabolism is ticking along well. The main flag is sleep: 4.9 hours simply isn't enough for proper recovery or fat loss progress toward that 80-85kg goal.

Your HRV at 102ms sits just below your baseline of 99-118ms, and with that sleep debt, your body is signalling it needs more rest than stress today. Keep any planned session light — a gentle run or easy movement rather than anything intense.

Tonight, prioritise getting 7-8 hours above everything else. Poor sleep elevates cortisol, which actively works against your weight target. Set a firm lights-out time and protect it like a training session — because right now, it absolutely is one.
